comment: Encapsulates information describing an MP4 track.

variables.name: TRANSFORMATION_CEA608_CDAT
variables.comment: A transformation for caption samples in cdat atoms.

variables.name: type
variables.comment: * One of {@link C#TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO}, {@link C#TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO} and {@link C#TRACK_TYPE_TEXT}.

variables.name: timescale
variables.comment: The track timescale, defined as the number of time units that pass in one second.

variables.name: durationUs
variables.comment: The duration of the track in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown.

variables.name: sampleTransformation
variables.comment:
* One of {@code TRANSFORMATION_*}. Defines the transformation to apply before outputting each
   * sample.

variables.name: editListDurations
variables.comment: Durations of edit list segments in the movie timescale. Null if there is no edit list.

variables.name: editListMediaTimes
variables.comment: Media times for edit list segments in the track timescale. Null if there is no edit list.

variables.name: nalUnitLengthFieldLength
variables.comment:
* For H264 video tracks, the length in bytes of the NALUnitLength field in each sample. 0 for
   * other track types.

methods.name: public TrackEncryptionBox getSampleDescriptionEncryptionBox(int sampleDescriptionIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link TrackEncryptionBox} for the given sample description index.
   *
   * @param sampleDescriptionIndex The given sample description index
   * @return The {@link TrackEncryptionBox} for the given sample description index. Maybe null if no
   *     such entry exists.
